exclude.WGPUINTERNAL_HAVE_EMDAWNWEBGPU_HEADER: Emdawnwebgpu's marker that its own header is in use, with a placeholder member; not part of the API.

handWritten.WGPUDeviceDescriptor.deviceLostCallbackI: A callback the device keeps: DeviceDescriptor.DeviceLost holds a delegate, released when the device-lost callback runs, which it does once for every device.
handWritten.WGPUDeviceDescriptor.uncapturedErrorCall: A callback the device keeps: DeviceDescriptor.UncapturedError holds a delegate, released with the device-lost callback's.
handWritten.wgpuBufferGetConstMappedRange: Returns a pointer: GpuBuffer.GetConstMappedRange returns a read-only span sized from the buffer.
handWritten.wgpuBufferGetMappedRange: Returns a pointer: GpuBuffer.GetMappedRange returns a span sized from the buffer.
handWritten.wgpuDevicePopErrorScope: Its callback reports an error type and a message on success: Device.PopErrorScopeAsync returns them as a GpuError.

skip.WGPUDawnCacheDeviceDescriptor: Holds callbacks the device keeps, with no notification that ends their lifetime.
skip.WGPUSharedBufferMemoryHostPointerDescrip: Holds a dispose callback info, which the library calls once it no longer uses the memory; no use needs it yet.
skip.wgpuDeviceSetLoggingCallback: A callback the device keeps, with no notification that ends its lifetime.
skip.wgpuGetProcAddress: Returns a function pointer of the C API, which the bindings call directly.
